# Generative_Graph_Models

**Domain**: TCC

## Definition
Deep generative models that learn to produce new graph structures or higher-order topological objects from a learned distribution. Allows synthesis of novel network topologies and routing patterns, supporting design-space exploration for topology-centric computing systems.
